title: git kura pre-commit component metadata
description: Schema for the componentMetadata blob of the pre-commit tool component, stored in the tools metadata store.

installState.description: Current install state: 'pending' means the config switch has been attempted but not verified; 'installed' means the switch is complete and consistent.

previousLocalHooksPathState.description: Whether core.hooksPath had a value in repository-local scope before install ('set' or 'unset').

previousLocalHooksPathValue.description: The repository-local core.hooksPath value before install. Empty when previousLocalHooksPathState is 'unset'.

previousHooksPathState.description: Whether core.hooksPath had an effective value (from any scope) before install ('set' or 'unset').

previousHooksPathValue.description: The raw effective core.hooksPath value before install. Stored verbatim so a relative value is resolved per-worktree at hook runtime.

newHooksPathValue.description: The absolute path install wrote to repository-local core.hooksPath.

managedHooksRoot.description: Root directory of the git-kura managed hook tree. Uninstall removes this whole tree.

wrapperPath.description: Absolute path to the managed pre-commit wrapper script.

wrapperChecksum.description: SHA-256 hex checksum of the managed wrapper script content, used to detect external modification.
